title: OpenPlanning Parcel Schema v1
description: Loads parcel records for a municipality. Natural key is {municipality, parcel_id}. Supports Regrid GeoJSON field mapping. Geometry stored as GeoJSON Polygon.

refreshed_at.description: Date the source data was last refreshed.

parcel_ref.description: Canonical natural-key reference to a Parcel within a municipality. Required: street_name, city, state. Optional: street_number, street_suffix (carry empty strings when not applicable; the keys must always be present). Resolution: case-insensitive exact match on street_name; when street_number or street_suffix are non-empty the match must agree on those too. The address fields mirror the Parcel model directly, so no parsing is performed. Other specs (application/v1, document/v1, project/v1, etc.) reference this definition via $ref.

street_number.description: House or building number (e.g. '7306'). Empty string for unaddressed parcels such as named subdivision lots.

street_name.description: Street name without number or suffix (e.g. 'Springfield'). For unaddressed parcels, the full descriptive name lives here (e.g. 'Enclave at Parkside', 'Warfield Parcel B').

street_suffix.description: Street suffix (e.g. 'Ave', 'Rd', 'St'). Empty string when not applicable.

parcel_id.description: State/county-assigned parcel identifier (parcelnumb). NULL when the source has no real identifier (e.g., right-of-way, unknown). Do NOT fabricate from internal IDs.

street_number.description: House or building number. Empty string for unaddressed parcels.

street_name.description: Street name without number or suffix. For unaddressed parcels, the descriptive name, e.g. 'Warfield Parcel B'.

zoning_code.description: Zoning district code. Resolved to ZoningDistrict by code within jurisdiction.
